results.title: Exploring Melbourne's Major Sporting Venues
results.description:
Sports commentators are fond of referring to Melbourne as the sporting capital of Australia.

The purpose of this map is to help new-comers to Melbourne to find the city's major sporting venues, and to provide a small amount of information, with a link to find out more.

The map can be used to find venues of interest and plan a journey to visit those venues.

The map shows how there is a cluster of venues South-East of the CBD, with other venues scattered through suburban Melbourne, more densely in the inner suburbs.

Use the Bookmarks to find the premier venue for sports of interest.

Also note that the pins are roughly colour-coded as follows:

* Red - major outdoor stadium/venue.
* Blue - major indoor stadium/venue.
* Green - water sport venue.
* Yellow - horse sport venue.
* Purple - related to Melbourne's most popular sport - Australian Rules Football.
results.snippet: This map features the locations of major sporting venues in Melbourne, including pop-up images and links. The purpose of this map is to help new-comers to Melbourne to find the city's major sporting venues. Find and visit your venues of interest.

results.title: Lifeline - Food/Hydration/Shelter - Live - Point - Major Sport Venues (HIFLD)
results.description:
Source Item: https://fema.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=1f538e9e89e642f1b077872933401d8d

The Major Sport Venues dataset is composed of facilities within the United States, Canada, and Mexico that host events for the National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing (NASCAR), Indy Racing League (IRL), Major League Soccer (MLS), Major League Baseball (MLB), National Basketball Association (NBA), Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA), National Hockey League (NHL), National Football League (NFL), Professional Golfers Association (PGA) Tour, National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Division 1-Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS), National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Division 1 Basketball, National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Division 1 Baseball, Minor League Baseball (MiLB) Class Triple-A, and thoroughbred horse racing. Large numbers of people congregate at these facilities to attend major sporting events, therefore the locations of these facilities and the characteristics that describe each facility is essential for emergency preparedness, response, and evacuation. In the latest update 16 features were added and 9 removed.
results.snippet: This dataset was developed to provide the locations of major sports venues and information about each facility and its specified use for the Homeland Infrastructure Foundation - Level Data (HIFLD) database.

results.title: Major sports venues & hh income
results.description: I chose to implement the amount of major sport venues on a map, that also displays the median household income in the United States, to show how household income as well as population affect where a sports complex is located. As you can see on the map, there are sport venues all through out the United States but, the venues are of greater proportion in the areas on the map with households of higher income.
results.snippet: Showing the correlation between, the level of income and amount of sport venues in a specific area

results.title: Major Sports Venues Vs. Population
results.description: This map is comparing major sports arenas with the amount of people located in each state. When looking at this map you can tell that there are more people living in New York so they have more sports arenas. New York has almost sixteen or more different sports venues while Vermont only has about two. This most likely because there are fewer people living Vermont than New York.

results.title: Major Sports Venues and Their North American Audience
results.description:
This map shows all major sports venues in North America. The Major Sports Venues dataset is composed of facilities within the United States, Canada, and Mexico that host events for associations such as NASCAR, Indy Racing League (IRL), Major League Soccer (MLS), Major League Baseball (MLB), National Basketball
Association (NBA), Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA), and many more.

Map Link: https://ohiostate.maps.arcgis.com/home/webmap/viewer.html?webmap=7fb73b4337274c75ae248f942492d0bf

This map is a 3D visualization of the Major Sports Venues (displayed as dots) and the most populated cities in America displayed in 3D format. The height of the visualization is based on the population, meaning the taller the city, the higher the population. This map shows that the places in which the sports venues were most prevalent were in the highest populated cities.
results.snippet: My project's main point will be to determine which North American sports association has the largest physical audience based on attendance
